repos_data.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable AI LLMs to trade using MetaTrader platform

MetaTrader 5 in a real Windows VM (Docker + QEMU/KVM), driven over REST + MCP — programmatic trading plus server-side TA: OHLC bars enriched with RSI/MACD/Bollinger/ADX/VWAP/Ichimoku/Order Blocks/FVGs (primitives, not signals). Typed MCP tools mirror the whole surface. Multi-broker, multi-account. No Wine bullshit.
Runnable Python examples for MT4/MT5 trading via TradeMux — no MQL, no custom bridge.
